rubric_items.reason: Each of REQ-1 to REQ-11 is traced by exactly one story, including assumed REQ-11: S-1 covers REQ-1 to 5, S-2 covers REQ-6 and 7, S-3 covers REQ-8 to 11.
Each story has one outcome. S-2 may grow if Q-03 resolves to its default (add the missing doctor/day filters in this change), and that extra scope is not split out.

All criteria use Given/When/Then. S-1 AC4 is now an observable number comparison (prior F-1 fixed). S-3 AC3/AC4 still do not name the filters and search they check, so the regression check stays open-ended.
Every value comes from req.md: Today, Asia/Kolkata, Cancelled, 0, 20 per page, sorted by name, the column list and the Appointments today tile.
Terms are clear and consistent. The body ACs now match the front-matter ACs word for word (prior F-4 fixed), and U-6 now agrees with S-2 (prior F-3 fixed).
